d.ko: Become an apprentice of the famous Leonardo da Vinci. Solve handcrafted mechanical 3D puzzles and discover hidden secrets. Navigate through mesmerizing environments of the Italian Renaissance. Travel through time to influence your surroundings.
d.en: Become an apprentice of the famous Leonardo da Vinci. Solve handcrafted mechanical 3D puzzles and discover hidden secrets. Navigate through mesmerizing environments of the Italian Renaissance. Travel through time to influence your surroundings.
d.zh: 化身列奥纳多·达芬奇的学生，破解精心设计的3D机械谜题，拨开重重迷雾，往返意大利文艺复兴时期的各个迷人城市，穿越时空，改变你身边的事物。
